literal_meaning: লোক না পোকা (না মানুষ, না পোকামাকড়)
figurative_meaning_en: insignificant or worthless like an insect
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তো লোক-না-পোকা, কেউ তাকে গুরুত্ব দেয় না।
example_sentences_in_english: He's just a nobody, no one takes him seriously.
What can you expect from such an insignificant person?
note: This idiom emphasizes extreme worthlessness, common in everyday Bengali discourse to dismiss someone's value.
